root_cause.summary: Windows entered System Idle sleep while a Codex subprocess was active. The runner could not execute its deadline loop while the host slept and terminated the run immediately after resume.

process_runner_changes: Hold SetThreadExecutionState(ES_CONTINUOUS | ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED) for each Windows EvalOps subprocess.
Fail closed before spawn when sleep inhibition cannot be established.
Surface sleep-inhibitor restore failures as process cleanup failures.
Add timeout_deadline_overrun when terminal duration exceeds the configured deadline by more than five seconds.
